غُمَّى : see غَمٌّ, latter half, in four places. ―
-b2- Also (assumed tropical:) A calamity, or misfortune; and so ↓ غَمَّآءُ ; (K, TA;) and ↓ غُمَّآءُ , likewise, is said to be allowable. (TA. [But this last I think doubtful.]) And (assumed tropical:) A hard, or difficult, affair or case, in relation to which one knows not the right course to pursue; as also ↓ غَمَّى , (K, TA,) and ↓ غَمَّآءُ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
